title: On-demand hold preempts spot work and reopens the Kanbus chore
description:
As a human I take the pool back. Spotticus SIGTERMs the spot runner, sets a hold, and returns the Kanbus chore to open.

Feature: preempt
  Scenario: hold stops dispatch
    Given a hold is set
    When Spotticus dispatches
    Then it does not start a spot run

  Scenario: preempt requeues
    Given a live spot run for chore C
    When Spotticus preempts
    Then the runner is signaled to stop
    And chore C is open on Kanbus again
